buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 1 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 3. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 4. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Technical Specifications Requirement: The quoted laptop must strictly comply with the following specifications: Processor: Intel Core i3, 13th Generation or higher RAM: 8 GB or higher (Must feature 1x PCIe x16 and at least 2x PCIe x1 slots) and a minimum capability to expand RAM up to 64GB or 128GB) Storage: 512 GB SSD Display: 14-inch Full HD Operating System: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS

Laptop Body: Aluminum metallic body The quoted model must match these specifications without deviation. 2. Warranty Requirement: The quoted laptop must come with a clearly mentioned 3 years onsite OEM warranty, which must explicitly include 3 years onsite OEM warranty coverage for both the battery and the adapter. This warranty detail m ust be verifiable in the OEM’s official documentation or on the OEM’s official website. 3. OEM Specification Verification: The quoted laptop’s specifications and warranty must exactly match the bid requirements and must be ver ifiable on the OEM’s official website by the buyer at any stage of evaluation or delivery. 4. OEM-Branded Accessories Requirement: Each laptop must be supplied with one wireless mouse and one laptop bag, both of which must be original and OEM-branded to match the brand of the quoted laptop, and any offer of third-party or unbranded acce ssories will be considered non-compliant and may result in rejection of the bid or supplied goods. 5. Delivery Timeline: The entire quantity of laptops must be delivered to the consignee within 7 calendar days from the date of GeM contract generation. Any delay beyond this timeline may lead to cancellation of the order without any liability on the buyer. 6. Mandatory Product Declaration Letter: The bidder must upload a signed and stamped declaration on their official letterhead, confirming the make and model of the quoted laptop, complete technical specifications as per the bid, warranty coverage includ ing battery and adapter, brand and model of the included accessories mouse and bag, the serial number of the sample laptop, and a firm commitment to deliver the items within 7 calendar days from the date of Ge M contract generation. 7. Manufacturer Authorization Form MAF: The bidder must upload a Bid-specific Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) issued by the OEM, addressed to the consignee as per bid details, and clearly mentioning the GeM Bid Number. Bids without t he required MAF will be treated as non-compliant and rejected. 8. OEM must have successfully supplied at least 500/1000 units of similar computing devices to a Central/S tate Government/PSU department in a single order within the last 3 years 9. Direct OEM Service Centers (Every District of Kerala) 10. Compliance at Final Delivery: At the time of delivery, the supplied products must conform fully to the technical specifications, warranty t erms, and accessory requirements as per the contract. Any deviation may result in rejection of the delivery, cancellation of the order, and necessary action under GeM terms and conditions. .
